Agent montuje eksport (mount -t nfs, opc: The agent mounts the export (mount -t nfs, options hard,_netdev) at /var/lib/virthub/mnt/ID on every attached node and keeps qcow2 files on it. The export must allow writes from the nodes' addresses (no_root_squash or owner libvirt-qemu).
Agent montuje udział (mount -t cifs, SMB: The agent mounts the share (mount -t cifs, SMB 3) at /var/lib/virthub/mnt/ID. The password only goes into a credentials file for the duration of the mount.
Agent loguje się do celu (iscsiadm) i mo: The agent logs in to the target (iscsiadm) and mounts the LUN at /var/lib/virthub/mnt/ID. The LUN must already have a filesystem — a cluster one (OCFS2, GFS2) if you attach the datastore to several nodes; plain ext4/XFS only for a single node.
Szablon określa replikację i rozmieszcze: The template sets replication and placement (storpool template list). Nodes must be StorPool cluster clients (storpool_block); a server disk is a volume attached as /dev/storpool/NAME.
Token z uprawnieniami do projektu (lbcli: A token with permissions for the project (lbcli). Nodes need lbcli and nvme-cli; a volume gets an ACL with the NQN of the host that created it. Subsystem NQN and data addresses: lbcli get cluster, lbcli list nodes.
Sterownik zgodny z dokumentacją producen: The driver follows the vendor's documentation but has not been tested on a real cluster. Snapshots: StorPool yes, Lightbits no. External backups are full.

Attach the datastore to nodes and to a VPS package — new servers from the package are created in it. Without a datastore the disk goes to the node's default directory.
